source_title: Attilio Unveils the Dr. Verdin Baseline Assessment, a Nine Part Study of Biological Age - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
The assessment measures six core functions of aging, with every component selected for clinical value over novelty.
ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Attilio today detailed the Dr. Verdin Baseline Assessment(TM), a nine part study of biological age designed with Dr. Eric Verdin, President and CEO of the Buck Institute for Research on Aging, now available to members for $2,500.
The assessment measures six core functions of aging: executive function, stress, cardio, respiratory, metabolism, and muscle and bone. Components include full panel labs, a DEXA scan, VO2 max testing, and continuous glucose monitoring, among others, each selected for clinical value over novelty.
Results land in a member's Health Wallet (TM), a single place that holds all of a member's lab results, scans, and wearable data, rather than scattered across different portals and PDFs. From there, a dedicated Health Architect(TM), a real person assigned to each member, turns those results into a plan: what to eat, how to train, and what to ask a doctor about next. Every member also receives a one on one session with Michele Miller, Director of Attilio Health, to walk through what the results mean and what to do next.
"A lab report means very little to most people without someone to explain it," said Michele Miller, Director of Attilio Health. "My job is to sit down with every member and turn their numbers into something they can actually act on." [DRAFT QUOTE, PENDING MICHELE MILLER'S APPROVAL]
"Most people never get a real answer for how they are actually aging," said Paul A. Pagnato, CEO & Founder of Attilio. "Eric designed an assessment that gives them one, at a price that does not require a fortune."
Attilio Mission: Democratize access to +100Year Quality Lifespan, reaching 99% of U.S. population.
Learn more about Attilio at www.attilio.com .
Attilio is a Human powered AI Life Optimization Platform(TM), technology, and Stewardship built to help people live longer, healthier lives. Every membership operates under the company's Conflict-Free Standards(TM): no commissions, no revenue sharing, no self-dealing. Attilio launched in September 2026 under CEO & Founder Paul A. Pagnato, working with experts from Stanford University, Harvard University, and the Buck Institute for Research on Aging.
